scope: Full Muse regression recheck: capture, completed-file analysis, source conditioning, composition, playback, export, persistence, producer, reference matching and accounts

verification.productionSmoke: passed: SQLite health, producer status, HTML/assets, SPA route, source containment, project read API
verification.gitDiffCheck: passed; existing Windows line-ending warnings only

reproducedAndFixed: Fractional-period sampling error caused supported high notes to drop to false subharmonics.
Stereo channel selection could favor loud encoder padding beyond the capture cutoff.
Incomplete trailing RIFF chunks and missing padding were accepted; Python also accepted inconsistent container lengths.
Client API response-body timeouts were described as malformed responses rather than deadlines.
Expired conditioning blocked subsequent arrangement despite retaining the original take. Renewal now coalesces and verifies identical audio SHA plus the complete melody before one retry.
Transposition could exceed the shared contour frequency limit and leave an unsavable melody. Rejected edits now preserve the current project and source binding.
MIDI backing note-offs could release a same-pitch lead on the same channel.
Solo piano, piano/strings combinations and negative bass requests left unwanted layers or lost requested instruments. Explicit requested percussion is retained.
Local saves could silently lose damaged notes/contours, round fractional BPM, or create a library larger than its own read limit.
Invalid reference metadata, spectra or confidence could produce erroneous candidates.
Neural generation had no concurrency bound or shutdown cancellation, and some failed response streams were not cancelled.
Expired conditioning audio stayed in idle memory until another request. Unreferenced expiry timers now dispose it on schedule.
Malformed successful account responses could reach application state and break rendering.
Account form limits counted Unicode UTF-16 units differently from the server.
A session cookie rotated by another tab left sign-out using a stale CSRF token. One bounded session refresh now recovers.
limits: Passing these regressions does not prove the absence of every possible error.
The human takes have no annotated melody ground truth; low voiced coverage remains explicitly warned.
Real MusicGen inference was not run. Python tests use actual Torch tensors with a model double, not downloaded neural weights.
Exact rendered comparisons use isolated lead stems. Polyphonic full-mix transcription and subjective listening quality are not established by these tests.
The reference matcher returns a conservative similarity candidate, not a verified transcription of Alone or guaranteed song identification.
MIDI preserves discrete notes and gates; continuous pitch contours are rendered in playback and WAV.
